description: X/Twitter deep lead finder — one call does the whole search -> profile -> contact chain: searches up to 4 pages, finds the PEOPLE behind the posts, enriches the top 10-15 with their own website (emails, LinkedIn, GitHub) and clusters them with a one-line why-they-match each. Recruiting, B2B prospecting, cofounder/investor search. Costs $0.20 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (get a key with buy_credits or at /buy/credits). A failed or empty call is free.

max.description: Optional. How many people to enrich, 1-15 (default 10).

query.description: Advanced X search query, e.g. '"open to work" rust'
